body: This modpack makes the game more fun with the Create mod and its add-ons. Besides that, there are new swords, optimization mods, fun add-ons, and mods to make things easier for players. There are also new blocks for building, and a world-building, biomes-o-pleasure mod. Additionally, there are the Northern Lights at night, rainbows after rain, waves, and new animals. There's also an essential mod for playing with friends. Unfortunately, you can't install shaders; for some unknown reason, the game crashes when you install the Iris shaders mod, and Create Aeronautics doesn't work either, which also causes crashes. I haven't changed the main menu yet; I'm currently learning the Fancy Menu mod. I'll fix that once I learn it. Have fun!
